Q: Spark context 'sc' not defined A:

You need to do the following after you have PySpark in your path:

from pyspark import SparkContext

sc = SparkContext()

Q: Prevent a label from "scrolling" when a count is being updated from a ListView control A:

Try this:

Public Class Form1

    Private Sub ListView1_ItemSelectionChanged(sender As Object, e As ListViewItemSelectionChangedEventArgs) Handles ListView1.ItemSelectionChanged
        Label2.Text = Format(ListView1.SelectedItems.Count, "000;;#")
    End Sub

    Private Sub Button1_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs) Handles Button1.Click
        ' ********** Select All button **********
        RemoveHandler ListView1.ItemSelectionChanged, AddressOf ListView1_ItemSelectionChanged
        For Each item In ListView1.Items
            If item.Selected = False Then item.Selected = True
        Next
        AddHandler ListView1.ItemSelectionChanged, AddressOf ListView1_ItemSelectionChanged
        ListView1_ItemSelectionChanged(ListView1, Nothing)
    End Sub

    ' --

    Private Sub Button3_Click(sender As Object, e As EventArgs) Handles Button3.Click
        ' ********** Select None button **********
        RemoveHandler ListView1.ItemSelectionChanged, AddressOf ListView1_ItemSelectionChanged
        For Each item In ListView1.Items
            If item.Selected = True Then item.Selected = False
        Next
        AddHandler ListView1.ItemSelectionChanged, AddressOf ListView1_ItemSelectionChanged
        ListView1_ItemSelectionChanged(ListView1, Nothing)
    End Sub

    ' --

End Class

Q: How do I copy an array N amount of times via formula, stacking it in the end of other A:

I decided to post an answer after all, even though you have sone perfect answers already.

The TOROW/SEQUENCE combination, posted by Mayukh would be my preference, but it relies on TOROW, which not all Excel versions support.

This would also work (spill) in Excel 2021:

=LET(array,A1:J1,n,5,INDEX(array,SEQUENCE(,COUNTA(array)*n,1,1/n)))

And this would work in older versions:

=INDEX($A$1:$J$1,ROUNDUP(COLUMN(A1)/5,))

(dragged to the right)

Q: Timeout for user decision in Windows batch file A:

Just want to add my simplified version of TrevorPeyton’s solution.

I needed to change in my case a preconfigured domain in my script:

set DOM=test.com
echo Preconfigured domain: %DOM%
choice /c sn /d n /t 10 /M "Change it?"
if not ERRORLEVEL 2 set /p DOM="Enter domain: "
echo Setting domain: %DOM%

Q: SSH.NET Library Installation in Visual Studio A:

1) You can install the nuget package manager if you don't yet have in your VS 2010. This link will help you install nuget package manager.

2) After you have nuget manager then you can right click on your project in visual studio, click 'Manage Nuget Packages' and in the browse window that appears search for 'SSH.Net', once the package is listed click on install option to install the package with your project.

Q: com.maverick.ssh.SshException: EOF received from remote side [Unknown cause] A:

The java code in question is using the J2SSH Maverick API from SSHTOOLS Limited and is throwing the exception during key exchange. This specific error means the remote server disconnected whilst key exchange was being performed.

There are many potential reasons for this. It's likely that the server did not like something in the key exchange messages and disconnected or even seg-faulted. The resolution would be to ensure your using the latest version of the API above and if it continues to be a problem contact the company for support.
